critical_paths: Guest listing returns only active products with valid pagination
PDP suppresses add-to-cart affordance for non-sellable products
Admin product edits emit audit events and remain idempotent under replay

test_cases.scenario_ref: Guest sees only active products in listing

expected_assertions.description: the listing returns exactly the 12 active products
no product with status in {draft, paused, deleted} appears in the response
pagination metadata is present in the response
the listing returns only products whose category_id = Electronics
the count badge reflects the filtered count
the URL contains the filter parameter for shareability

test_cases.scenario_ref: Filter by in-stock-only excludes out-of-stock items

expected_assertions.description: the response returns only the 10 products where stock_available > 0
no product with stock_available = 0 appears

test_cases.scenario_ref: Price range filter rejects invalid bounds

expected_assertions.description: the listing returns an empty result with an explanation that min must be <= max
no server error is raised
the previous filter state is recoverable

test_cases.scenario_ref: Public listing endpoint never surfaces admin-only fields or non-active products (banking_grade authn_authz)

expected_assertions.description: anonymous guest caller receives only status=active products
response payload omits admin-only fields (e.g. cost price, supplier notes) regardless of caller
no product with status in {draft, paused, deleted} appears even when caller crafts arbitrary query parameters

test_cases.scenario_ref: Active product PDP shows add-to-cart affordance

expected_assertions.description: the page renders name, SKU, description, all images, current price, compare-at price, in-stock indicator, average rating 4.2, and review count 11
the add-to-cart button is enabled

test_cases.scenario_ref: Paused product PDP shows unavailable message instead of add-to-cart

expected_assertions.description: the page renders product metadata for reference
the add-to-cart button is replaced by an unavailable-message block with the Thai unavailable copy
no add-to-cart request can be sent from this view

test_cases.scenario_ref: Soft-deleted product reached via direct URL returns 404 or unavailable view

expected_assertions.description: the response is HTTP 404 OR an unavailable view with the same Thai unavailable copy
no add-to-cart affordance is rendered

test_cases.scenario_ref: PDP response never surfaces admin-only product attributes regardless of caller (banking_grade authn_authz)

expected_assertions.description: PDP response omits admin-only attributes such as cost price and supplier notes for anonymous callers
PDP response payload is identical (no extra fields) when called with arbitrary or forged caller headers

test_cases.scenario_ref: Admin creates a product with all required fields

expected_assertions.description: a new product row is created with the submitted values
the response includes the product id
the product appears in the admin catalog list with status=active
the request is rejected with a field-level error on SKU
no new product is created

test_cases.scenario_ref: Price change emits an audit event

expected_assertions.description: product P1 has price=999 after the edit is saved
an audit event is emitted with payload containing event='product.price_changed', actor, ts (ISO-8601), before.price=1290, after.price=999, reason, and idem_key
the audit event payload does NOT contain any password, token, or card data

test_cases.scenario_ref: Edit attempt to mutate SKU is rejected

expected_assertions.description: the request is rejected with a field-level error stating SKU is immutable
no change is persisted
the audit log records no successful SKU change

test_cases.scenario_ref: Idempotent product-edit replay produces no duplicate audit

expected_assertions.description: no additional state change occurs when the same idempotency_key='ik-prod-001' request is replayed
no duplicate audit event is emitted for the replayed request
the response returns the original result

test_cases.scenario_ref: Non-admin caller is rejected from admin product CRUD surface (banking_grade authn_authz)

expected_assertions.description: guest caller invoking the admin create-product endpoint receives 401/403 and no product row is created
customer-role caller invoking the admin edit-product endpoint receives 403 and no state change is persisted
rejected admin-endpoint calls do not emit a successful-write audit event

test_cases.scenario_ref: Soft-delete and price edit are reversible by inverse admin action with full audit trail (banking_grade reversibility)

expected_assertions.description: flipping status from active to paused and back to active leaves the product row in the original active state
re-editing price from 999 back to 1290 restores the original price value
each reversing action emits its own audit event with before/after deltas; no audit row is mutated or removed

test_data_specs.synthesis_rules: 20 seed products: 12 with status=active and stock_available>0 (10 in-stock + 2 will be toggled out-of-stock for the in-stock-only filter test), 8 with status in {draft, paused, deleted}. Distribute the 12 active products across 5 categories with Electronics having at least 3 SKUs. Include bilingual product names (Thai + English) sourced from the BA glossary surface forms. Each product carries: SKU (immutable), slug, name, description, image, price (>0), compare-at price (nullable), category_id, stock_available, status, public/hidden flag. Includes a soft-deleted product P3 reachable by deep link, an active product P1 (price=1290, stock=5, rating=4.2, review_count=11), and a paused product P2.

Admin actor records (role=admin, username='aoy' and a second admin for concurrency tests) used as audit-event actors only — no customer PII. Pre-existing product with SKU 'SKU-EL-001', price=1290, status=active, category=Electronics, stock=10 to support duplicate-SKU rejection, price-change audit, SKU-immutability, and idempotent-replay scenarios. Pre-issued idempotency_key 'ik-prod-001' bound to one prior successful edit. Reason-for-change free-text seed values for audit payload assertions.
